name: BGM Change
description: Changes the background music when its trigger conditions are met.

fields.name: Music to be Played
fields.description: Selects the background music or event track.

0.name: Area / Variable
0.description: The music changes when the area or variable condition is met.

1.name: Area
1.description: The music changes when a player enters the defined area.

2.name: Layer (Multiplayer Area)
2.description: In single-player, the music changes when the player is on the actor's layer. In multiplayer, a player must be inside the defined area.

3.name: Mode 3
3.description: Appears to behave similarly to Mode 0, but has different music activation and priority behavior.

4.name: Mode 4 (Unused?)
4.description: Appears to behave similarly to Mode 0, but differs in how it handles certain existing music states.

fields.name: Sub Music (Single-player only)
fields.description: When enabled, targets the GBA layer music instead of the main TV music in single-player mode.

fields.name: Area Width
fields.description: Sets the horizontal trigger extent. The stored value is increased by 1 before being scaled into world units.

fields.name: Area Height
fields.description: Sets the vertical trigger extent. The stored value is increased by 1 before being scaled into world units.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable associated with the trigger.
